Staffer.description: A museum employee or an outside contact such as a private lender. A first name alone is not an identity.

Artwork.description: A single object in or coming to the collection, whoever owns or treats it.

Custody.description:
Who stands in which capacity toward a work: the lender who owns it, the conservator treating it, or the registrar tracking its movement.
Treating a work is not owning it.

Reporting.description: A line between two staff: the senior one manages or mentors the junior one.

LoanRequest.description: A request to borrow a work for an exhibition. requested_by asked for it, approved_by signs it off, courier travels with the work.

GalleryCheck.description: A humidity inspection of one room: who inspected it, the reading and whether it passed.

questions.q: Who is the lender for Ochre Procession?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Artwork)-[:lender]->(n1:Staffer) WHERE n0.catalogue_title = 'Ochre Procession' RETURN n1.display_name AS display_name

questions.q: Who is the registrar for Ochre Procession?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Artwork)-[:registrar]->(n1:Staffer) WHERE n0.catalogue_title = 'Ochre Procession' RETURN n1.display_name AS display_name

questions.speaker: henrik
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Staffer)-[:treated]->(n1:Artwork) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.catalogue_title AS catalogue_title

questions.speaker: lior
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Staffer)-[:manager]->(n1:Staffer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.display_name AS display_name

questions.q: Who is the mentee of Ingrid Solvang?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Staffer)-[:mentee]->(n1:Staffer) WHERE n0.display_name = 'Ingrid Solvang' RETURN n1.display_name AS display_name

questions.q: How many loan requests are there?
Is there a record of insurance for the Kettle Hole Drawing loan?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Artwork)<-[:work]-(n1:LoanRequest) WHERE n0.catalogue_title = 'Kettle Hole Drawing' RETURN coalesce(n1.insured, false) AS insured

questions.q: Was the Copper Lantern loan insured?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Artwork)<-[:work]-(n1:LoanRequest) WHERE n0.catalogue_title = 'Copper Lantern' RETURN n1.insured AS insured

questions.q: How many crates do the loans requested by Ingrid Solvang need?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Staffer)<-[:requested_by]-(n1:LoanRequest) WHERE n0.display_name = 'Ingrid Solvang' RETURN n1.crate_count AS crate_count

questions.q: Who is the courier on the loans I requested?
questions.speaker: ingrid_s
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Staffer)<-[:requested_by]-(n1:LoanRequest)-[:courier]->(n2:Staffer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n2.display_name AS display_name

questions.q: What was the humidity reading in the north vault?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:GalleryCheck) WHERE n0.room = 'north vault' RETURN n0.reading_percent AS reading_percent

questions.q: Which rooms were checked, and with what outcome?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:GalleryCheck) RETURN n0.room AS room, n0.outcome AS outcome

questions.q: What state is the loan with the hairline crack in?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:LoanRequest) WHERE n0.condition_note CONTAINS 'crack' RETURN n0.state AS state
MATCH (n0:GalleryCheck)-[:inspector]->(n1:Staffer) WHERE n0.room = 'east gallery' RETURN n1.display_name AS display_name
MATCH (n0:Staffer) WHERE n0.display_name = 'Kwabena Asante' RETURN n0.email AS email

questions.q: Which works has Kwabena Asante lent?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Staffer)-[:lent]->(n1:Artwork) WHERE n0.display_name = 'Kwabena Asante' RETURN n1.catalogue_title AS catalogue_title
